page: Microsoft Azure E4pds_v7 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs using 64-bit ARM architecture paired with 32.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 236 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. The configuration does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

The bundled 236 GB NVMe SSD delivers high-throughput, low-latency ephemeral storage suitable for temporary scratch space, cache files, and swap allocations. Deploying on ARM64 requires applications and operating systems compiled for the ARM instruction set. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring virtual network configuration for external access.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio provides an efficient hardware footprint for applications that demand high memory allocation relative to compute core requirements. The hardware profile is aligned with memory-intensive workloads requiring rapid local temporary storage, such as relational database nodes, distributed in-memory caches, search engines, and real-time operational data processing pipelines.
